en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing two young men walking on a roadside with a white guardrail in front of a forested hillside. On the hill stands a large multi‑storey resort or sanatorium-type building with balconies, along with some smaller structures. The caption beneath the image is in Hungarian. The reverse side contains Hungarian handwriting in blue ink, a Hungarian stamp, postal cancellation and printed publisher information.
